property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array, C.transfer(...) always returns successfully (does not revert) when calling a counterparty that implements transferFrom(address,address,uint256); the mutant that uses a wrong selector can cause the external call to fail and thus makes transfer revert for some counterparty and inputs.
change_summary: Replace the external call to use a failing selector (wrong function signature) so the call will likely return false and cause revert where original might have succeeded.
